description: MassLegalHelp explains Massachusetts legal rights, and the Massachusetts Legal Resource Finder helps locate legal assistance. These tools help you find an appropriate provider
introduction: MassLegalHelp explains Massachusetts legal rights, and the Massachusetts Legal Resource Finder helps locate legal assistance. These tools help you find an appropriate provider for your civil legal problem.

who: People seeking information about Massachusetts civil legal matters, including housing, benefits, debt or family issues.
A referred legal provider applies its own service area, income and case acceptance rules.
sections.get: Self-help explanations and routes to legal aid or other legal resources. Reading a guide or searching the finder does not establish an attorney-client relationship.
sections.docs: Before contacting a provider, organize court papers, notices, dates, the other party’s name and a short account of the issue. Note your earliest deadline clearly. Ask the provider how to transmit sensitive documents.
sections.apply:
1. Read the relevant topic on MassLegalHelp.
  2. Use the Massachusetts Legal Resource Finder to identify assistance for your location and issue.
  3. Follow the named provider’s intake instructions and explain any court deadline first.
sections.after: Ask whether the provider has accepted the case and what help it will provide. Continue observing filing and hearing dates until a lawyer or court tells you otherwise. If the provider cannot take the matter, request another resource.

faqs: It provides legal information; use a referral resource and contact a provider for individual help.
